name: Find the Code
desc:
Welcome to Find The Code!👋🔎

Search for the hidden Codes in the Worlds to complete it and take access to discover more Worlds!

Earn coins, Buy tools, and have Fun!!

Don't forget to join our Group For daily Coins and Chat Tag!! ✅
